answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the kernel of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The ivory is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the trellis. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, diluted when peers disagree, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
